title: Body Science Context Atlas
purpose: Thicken the BODY branch with real anatomy, physiology and neuroscience while keeping every Potatoverse correspondence explicitly symbolic unless separately demonstrated.
boundary: Thalamus=House, Pineal=Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder and CSF=Spirit are project correspondences. The scientific layer below describes actual structures and functions and must not be presented as validation of those symbolic identities.

sections.science: The thalamus is a diencephalic structure composed of multiple nuclei with roles in sensory and motor relay, attention, learning, memory, sleep/wake regulation and broader thalamocortical computation. It is better described as a family of interconnected subnetworks than as one single relay switch.
sections.contextual_value: This makes 'House with rooms' a structurally richer analogy than a single mystical center: distinct nuclei/subnetworks receive, transform and route different streams while remaining part of one anatomical system.
sections.mismatch: The thalamus is not an empirically identified seat of God, Fatherhood or spiritual sovereignty.

sections.science: The pineal gland is a small neuroendocrine organ whose best-established role is melatonin production and circadian/light-dark signaling. Light information reaches the suprachiasmatic clock through retinal pathways and influences pineal melatonin via autonomic circuitry.
sections.contextual_value: The physically grounded themes are timing, darkness/light, rhythmic signaling and endocrine output—not an anatomical portal to another dimension.
sections.mismatch: Third-eye, Christ-Door and higher-dimensional meanings are historical/esoteric/project symbolism, not established neuroscience.

sections.science: Cerebrospinal fluid circulates through ventricles and subarachnoid spaces and contributes to buoyancy, mechanical protection, extracellular homeostasis, metabolic exchange and waste-clearance processes. Adult total volume is roughly 150 mL, with hundreds of milliliters produced per day.
sections.contextual_value: CSF is a genuinely circulating medium with rhythmic motion influenced by cardiac pulsation, respiration and posture, which explains why it is an intuitively strong flow metaphor.
sections.mismatch: Its physiological circulation is not evidence of a spiritual fluid or hidden energy current.

sections.science: Respiration is unusual because it is both autonomically regulated and voluntarily modifiable. Respiratory signals interact with interoceptive and autonomic systems; vagal sensory pathways convey internal-state information from respiratory, cardiovascular and gastrointestinal organs.
sections.contextual_value: Breath can legitimately be studied as a bridge between voluntary action, autonomic regulation, bodily state and subjective experience without invoking a new force.
sections.mismatch: Breath affecting attention, emotion or autonomic state does not establish supernatural pneuma or universal life energy.

sections.science: The vertebral column provides structural support, protects the spinal cord and permits constrained movement. Spinal cord pathways carry ascending sensory and descending motor/autonomic signals between brain and body.
sections.contextual_value: The spine is physically vertical, segmented and connectivity-bearing, which makes Ladder/Axis symbolism understandable as analogy.
sections.mismatch: Vertebral segmentation does not scientifically establish 33 metaphysical levels or a literal Ladder to Heaven.

sections.science: The heart is a muscular pump regulated by intrinsic conduction, autonomic input and endocrine/metabolic state. Emotional experience is distributed across brain-body systems rather than stored literally in the heart, but cardiovascular changes strongly participate in felt emotion and interoception.
sections.contextual_value: Keeping Heart distinct from Pineal/Thalamus protects a useful project distinction between affective bodily salience and perceptual/integrative brain metaphors.
sections.mismatch: The poetic heart is not a literal container of memories or moral qualities.

new_body_relations: Breath ↔ voluntary/autonomic boundary ↔ Door-like control interface
Vagus/interoception ↔ internal sensing ↔ Eye turned inward
research_questions: Can BODY distinguish anatomical structure, physiological process, subjective experience and symbolic interpretation as four separate layers?
Which body correspondences appeared first historically, and which were later systematized after the Axis model?
Can breath be modeled as a control input in Timic Dynamics without pretending it is a fundamental force?
Can the House metaphor be refined around thalamic subnetworks without implying one-to-one room=nucleus identities?
Can interoception become the scientific bridge between Eye, Heart, Breath and embodied Son without collapsing them?
